summary_en: This phase 2 study tests hypofractionated proton or photon radiation therapy in people with benign brain or nerve sheath tumors, such as meningiomas, pituitary adenomas, and schwannomas. Patients receive radiation daily, Monday through Friday, over 17 fractions (or 20 fractions for grade 2-3 meningiomas) for 3.5 to 4 weeks. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la radioterapia hipofraccionada con protones o fotones en personas con tumores benignos del cerebro o de las vainas nerviosas, como meningiomas, adenomas de hipófisis y schwannomas. Los pacientes reciben radiación diariamente, de lunes a viernes, en 17 fracciones (o 20 fracciones para meningiomas de grado 2-3) durante 3.5 a 4 semanas. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; es un estudio de fase II.
who_for: Benign intracranial or nerve sheath tumor, such as meningioma, pituitary adenoma, or schwannoma
WHO grade 2-3 meningiomas are also allowed
Recommended to receive proton or photon fractionated radiation therapy
not_for: Women who could become pregnant without a negative pregnancy test or adequate birth control
Prior radiation that overlaps with the current target area
Unable to undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
